reviewBoundary: Newly authored provisional primary-school text practices. Exact answer evidence and every distractor were checked by the author only; this is not independent teacher review, learner calibration, an official examination or publication approval.

materials.title: Broken Cup Classroom 019
materials.text: A cup breaks near the sink. The teacher says to stand back. Do not pick up the pieces. Ask an adult to clean them. The class uses the other sink for now. Tell anyone coming in that the first sink area is closed. The teacher will say when it is clear again.

questions.prompt: A friend reaches for a broken piece. You say, "____"
options: Please stand back and leave it.
Put the pieces in your pocket.
questions.explanation: A按要求退开不捡；B/C均让孩子处理碎片，违成人清理安排。

questions.prompt: A friend asks who should clean the pieces. You say, "____"
options: A toy robot with no power.
questions.explanation: B成人清理；A最幼孩子、C无电玩具非指定人员。

questions.prompt: A child wants to wash hands by the broken cup. You say, "____"
options: Use the other sink for now.
questions.explanation: C暂用另一水槽；A继续近碎杯、B踩碎片均与区域关闭相反。

questions.prompt: A friend comes in and walks towards the first sink. You say, "____"
options: That sink area is closed for now.
There is nothing to tell you.
questions.explanation: A告知封区；B不告知、C催跑均违提醒要求。

questions.prompt: The pieces look gone, and a friend wants to go back. You say, "____"
options: Wait until the teacher says it is clear.
questions.explanation: B待教师确认；A自行未经确认进入、C搬水槽均非复开条件。

materials.title: Lost Friend Fair Desk 019
materials.text: At the school fair, stay with your partner. If you cannot see your partner, go to the information desk. The desk has a yellow flag. Ask the helper there. Do not leave the school gate alone. Wait at the desk until the teacher comes. Give the helper your class name.

questions.prompt: You cannot find your partner. What should you say to the helper?
options: I cannot find my partner. Please help.
I want to leave alone now.
questions.explanation: B明确同伴失联并求助；A帽无关；C独离违反不出校门。

questions.prompt: A friend asks which desk gives help. You say, "____"
options: The one with a red toy.
The desk with the yellow flag.
questions.explanation: C黄旗信息台；A红玩具标、B校外任台非明确地点。

questions.prompt: A friend suggests looking outside the gate alone. You say, "____"
options: Stay here and ask the helper.
questions.explanation: A校内信息台求助；B/C离指定求助点且独行不合。

questions.prompt: The helper asks which class you are in. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: B提供班名供找人；A味道、C旗高均不答班级。

questions.prompt: A friend wants to wander off while waiting. You say, "____"
options: Wait at the desk for the teacher.
questions.explanation: C教师来前留台；A乱走、B翻墙违等待要求。

units.title: 花园游戏里的长元音词

materials.title: Long Vowels Garden Play 019
materials.text:
Match the vowel sound in the capitalised clue and complete each sentence. Use each bank word once. Bank: A. game B. rope C. white D. tube E. hide
1. Jake (JAKE) plays a board ____1____ with his sister.
2. Rose (ROSE) ties a toy to a long ____2____.
3. My bike (BIKE) is the colour of milk. It is ____3____.
4. The cute (CUTE) toy train goes through a round paper ____4____.
5. Mike (MIKE) says, "You look for me. I will ____5____ behind the tree."

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: A game与JAKE均/eɪ/且board game合义；B rope /əʊ/，C white和E hide /aɪ/，D tube /juː/不合元音和游戏名词搭配。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: B rope与ROSE均/əʊ/且可用来绑玩具；A game /eɪ/，C white和E hide /aɪ/，D tube /juː/不合读音及所需绳义。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: C white与BIKE均/aɪ/且奶色白；E hide同音但非颜色；A game /eɪ/、B rope /əʊ/、D tube /juː/不同音且不描述颜色。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: D tube与CUTE含/juː/且纸管可穿过；A game /eɪ/，B rope /əʊ/，C white和E hide /aɪ/不合读音与通道名词。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: E hide与MIKE均/aɪ/且躲树后让人找；C white同音却不是躲藏动词；A game /eɪ/、B rope /əʊ/、D tube /juː/均不合。

units.title: 下雨时换一个游戏房间

materials.title: Rainy Game Room Order 019
materials.text:
Order the conversation. The fixed opening is: 1. Our board game is outside, but it is raining.
A. Yes, it is empty. Let us take the game there.
B. Shall I carry the game box?
C. Can we play in the hall instead?
D. Yes, please. I will bring the chairs.
E. The hall is full. How about the art room?
Choose the position of each line from 2 to 6.

questions.prompt: What position does line A take?
questions.explanation: C第4步回答美术室提议并转移游戏；A第2步先问礼堂；B第3步答礼堂满并提美术室；D第5步问搬盒；E第6步分担椅子。

questions.prompt: What position does line B take?
questions.explanation: D第5步场地定后提出搬游戏盒；A第2步尚问地点；B第3步提美术室；C第4步确认；E第6步应回应搬运提议。

questions.prompt: What position does line C take?
questions.explanation: A第2步因雨先问可否礼堂；B第3步才能答礼堂满；C第4步美术室确认；D第5步搬盒；E第6步带椅均后于询礼堂。

questions.prompt: What position does line D take?
questions.explanation: E第6步答Shall I carry并分工带椅；A第2步问礼堂；B第3步提替代；C第4步确认；D第5步才问搬盒。

questions.prompt: What position does line E take?
questions.explanation: B第3步回答礼堂请求并提美术室；A第2步应先问礼堂；C第4步确认美术室；D第5步问搬盒；E第6步应分工搬椅。

materials.title: Banana Muffin Label 019
materials.text: My aunt gives me a paper bag. She says, "There are bananas in these cakes." I look inside and see three small muffins, not whole bananas. I take one to my brother. He asks why it smells sweet. I tell him about the banana in it. We eat at the kitchen table. We keep the third muffin for Dad, who is still at work.

questions.prompt: The bag contains three small muffins.
questions.explanation: A正确：three muffins；B否认数量和内容。

questions.prompt: There are three whole bananas in the bag instead of cakes.
questions.explanation: B正确：香蕉在糕里，并无完整香蕉；A误解aunt的话。

questions.prompt: The writer shares one muffin with the brother.
questions.explanation: A正确：take one to brother；B否认分享动作。

questions.prompt: They eat in the garden.
questions.explanation: B正确：kitchen table；A厨房改花园。

questions.prompt: One muffin is kept for Dad.
questions.explanation: A正确：third for Dad at work；B否认保留对象。

materials.title: Lost Library Key Ring 019
materials.text: After helping in the library, Anya cannot find the cupboard key. The librarian remembers hearing a little bell when Anya moved the book trolley. The key ring has a bell on it. They look under the trolley but find nothing. Anya pushes the trolley slowly, and they hear the sound again. A cloth bag hanging on its handle has a small side pocket. The key is inside. Anya remembers putting it there so she could carry books with both hands. She returns it to its hook and writes a reminder on her helper card.

questions.prompt: What helps the librarian think about the key’s location?
questions.explanation: A钥匙圈铃声线索；B蛋糕味、C车票无关。

questions.prompt: Where do they first look without success?
questions.explanation: B先车底找未见；A/C没去。

questions.prompt: Where is the key found?
options: On the floor under the wheel.
In a cloth bag’s side pocket.
questions.explanation: C挂车手柄布袋侧袋；A车底没找到；B书内无据。

questions.prompt: Why had Anya put the key there?
options: To free both hands for carrying books.
To hide it from the librarian.
questions.explanation: A腾双手抱书；B藏匿、C停读非动机。

questions.prompt: What does Anya do after finding it?
options: Return it to its hook and add a reminder.
questions.explanation: B归钩并卡写提醒；A带家、C扔卡均与原文相反。

units.title: 自行车打气课的记录卡

materials.title: Bike Pump Pressure Note 019
materials.text: At cycling club, an adult checks each tyre before pupils practise. A small card records the bike number and whether the tyres need air. Pupils do not decide by colour or size. Mei’s front tyre needs air, but the back tyre is fine. The adult adds air and checks again. Mei ticks only the front-tyre box after the check. At the end, the card goes back to the club folder, not into Mei’s bag, so the next helper can read it.

questions.prompt: An adult checks the tyres before practice.
questions.explanation: A正确：adult checks before pupils practise；B否认先后和人员。

questions.prompt: Tyre colour tells pupils how much air is needed.
questions.explanation: B正确：do not decide by colour；A将禁止依据当判断规则。

questions.prompt: Both of Mei’s tyres need air.
questions.explanation: B正确：仅front，back fine；A把一轮扩大两轮。

questions.prompt: Mei ticks the front-tyre box after the adult rechecks it.
questions.explanation: A正确：adds air checks again后勾front；B否认操作顺序。

questions.prompt: The card stays in the club folder for future helpers.
questions.explanation: A正确：回folder供next helper；B否认共享记录目的。

materials.title: Wet School Notice Cloze 019
materials.text:
Read the whole passage and choose a word for each numbered gap.
One ____1____ morning, rain hit the school gate. The notice outside was wet, and we could not read the ____2____ because the ink had spread. Instead of guessing, we asked the office for a ____3____ copy. Before putting it up, we ____4____ the date with the secretary. The meeting was on Thursday, not Tuesday, so we ____5____ the old notice. The caretaker showed us ____6____ to attach a waterproof cover, explaining each step. We held the corners ____7____ he could work with both hands. Finally, we placed the notice at a ____8____ height so younger pupils could read it too.

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: A rainy与rain hit一致；B sunny阳光、C dry干燥均不符合给定下雨早晨。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: B墨散导致通知文字难读；A轮子、C窗子不是通知中供阅读内容。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: C新副本可替湿通知；A空白无会议信息；B损坏副本不解决问题。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: A与秘书核日期；B擦掉日期无法确认；C丢日期不构成此搭配和目的。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: B新日期替旧通知；A装框不改错误，C藏起不完成张贴新安排。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 6?
questions.explanation: C show how to attach配逐步示范；A who不接此不定式表方法；B why说明原因而非given each step操作方式。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 7?
questions.explanation: A扶角使他可双手作业，so表结果目的；B转折、C选择不合此因果。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 8?
questions.explanation: B低处方便较小学生读；A隐藏不可读；C最高处与年轻学生可见目的冲突。

units.title: 植物交换会上的状态标签

materials.title: Plant Swap Health Tags 019
materials.text: The plant club held a swap with clear labels. Each pot showed the plant’s name, the date of its last watering and any known problem. One pot had yellow leaves. Its owner wanted to remove them so the plant would look healthier. A helper asked her to leave the label’s note about the problem even if damaged leaves were removed. A pretty display should not hide useful information from the next owner. Some plants had no confirmed name. Those were marked "Name not confirmed" and kept on a separate table for advice. Visitors could choose them, but helpers did not promise a name they had not checked.

questions.prompt: Labels included the last watering date.
questions.explanation: A正确：date last watering；B否认标签项目。

questions.prompt: Removing yellow leaves meant the problem note should also be removed.
questions.explanation: B正确：即便剪掉叶仍留问题说明；A将外观改善当信息删除理由。

questions.prompt: The helper valued giving the next owner useful information.
questions.explanation: A正确：不让漂亮展示掩信息；B否认明确理由。

questions.prompt: Every plant was given a confirmed name even when nobody knew it.
questions.explanation: B正确：不知标Name not confirmed；A把未核强称已核。

questions.prompt: Visitors could still choose a plant from the advice table.
questions.explanation: A正确：visitors could choose them；B把不确名误当禁止选择。

units.title: 义卖小组安排里的条件句

materials.title: Fair Team Arrangement 019
materials.text:
Choose the best reply for each question or situation. Use every reply once.
A. Only if a leader has confirmed the space.
B. Because the glue needs time to dry.
C. Put your name beside the task you can do.
D. I can take the later shift instead.
E. Please tell the leader before you change it.

questions.prompt: Can we set our stall anywhere in the hall?
options: Only if a leader has confirmed the space.
Because the glue needs time to dry.
Put your name beside the task you can do.
I can take the later shift instead.
Please tell the leader before you change it.
questions.explanation: A需负责人确认位置的条件答许可；B干胶原因、C登记、D改晚班、E换前告知均未直接设地点许可条件。

questions.prompt: Why must the display be finished the evening before?
options: Only if a leader has confirmed the space.
Because the glue needs time to dry.
Put your name beside the task you can do.
I can take the later shift instead.
Please tell the leader before you change it.
questions.explanation: B胶需干解释提前完成；A场地条件、C署名、D代班、E告知不答Why。

questions.prompt: How do I join a job on the volunteer sheet?
options: Only if a leader has confirmed the space.
Because the glue needs time to dry.
Put your name beside the task you can do.
I can take the later shift instead.
Please tell the leader before you change it.
questions.explanation: C可做任务旁写名答登记步骤；A许可、B干燥、D晚班、E变更告知均不答初次加入表。

questions.prompt: Your friend needs the early shift, and you offer to move to a later one.
options: Only if a leader has confirmed the space.
Because the glue needs time to dry.
Put your name beside the task you can do.
I can take the later shift instead.
Please tell the leader before you change it.
questions.explanation: D主动改晚班让早班给朋友；A场地、B干胶、C署名、E提醒不等于此分班提议。

questions.prompt: A teammate wants to change the checked volunteer sheet without telling anyone.
options: Only if a leader has confirmed the space.
Because the glue needs time to dry.
Put your name beside the task you can do.
I can take the later shift instead.
Please tell the leader before you change it.
questions.explanation: E修改已核志愿表前告诉负责人，回应未告知就改表；A仅涉及确认场地，与表格变更无关；B胶干原因、C初次署名、D主动调班都不要求修改前通知。

materials.title: Community Library Key Story 019
materials.text:
When the little community library’s caretaker was ill, volunteers could not find the main key. Ivo remembered a spare key hanging in his grandfather’s workshop. He ran to fetch it and was proud when it fitted the lock. Then he paused. His grandfather had once helped repair the door, but that did not explain whether the spare was still meant to be used by anyone.
Ivo phoned the library coordinator before turning it. She confirmed that his grandfather was an approved key holder and asked Ivo to wait until another volunteer arrived. Together they opened the library and recorded who had used the spare. Later, the coordinator made an up-to-date list of key holders and their contact details for authorised volunteers.
Ivo was still glad he had remembered the key. But he understood that having a way to open a door was only one part of solving the problem. Knowing who could authorise its use helped protect the shared space and the people responsible for it.

questions.prompt: Why could volunteers not open the library at first?
options: The caretaker was ill and the main key was missing.
questions.explanation: B看管人病且主钥找不到；A门仍在；C书未卖；D有志愿者。

questions.prompt: Why did Ivo pause after testing the spare key?
options: It did not fit the lock.
He was unsure whether he had permission to use it.
questions.explanation: C合锁不等于可自行使用；A已fits；B/D无据。

questions.prompt: Who confirmed that the grandfather was an approved key holder?
questions.explanation: A协调人确认；B路人、C全镇学生、D锁不能授权。

questions.prompt: What did Ivo do before opening the door?
options: Wait for another volunteer as requested.
questions.explanation: D按要求等第二志愿者；A卖、B藏来源、C独进均不符。

questions.prompt: What idea does the ending emphasise?
options: A fitting key gives unlimited permission.
Practical access and permission both matter.
questions.explanation: B能开门与授权两部分都重要；A否定叙事主旨；C未主张永闭；D实际通过电话核准。

units.title: 模型火车展的比例说明

materials.title: Train Model Scale 019
materials.text:
The model club displayed two trains beside each other. One was longer, so visitors assumed the real train it represented must also be longer. In fact, the models used different scales. The shorter model represented a larger real train. The pupils had forgotten to put the scale labels on the display.
They added the labels and a small diagram explaining that models made at different scales cannot be compared by model length alone. They also placed a note saying which dimensions had been simplified for easier construction. The exhibition still showed the models together, but it invited visitors to read the labels before drawing conclusions. The pupils learned that accurate-looking objects could mislead when important context was left out.

questions.prompt: The two model trains were built at the same scale.
questions.explanation: B正确：different scales；A把不同改相同。

questions.prompt: The longer model necessarily represented the longer real train.
questions.explanation: B正确：较短模型反代表更大实车；A重复游客误推。

questions.prompt: The original display lacked scale labels.
questions.explanation: A正确：forgot scale labels；B否认信息缺口。

questions.prompt: The pupils explained that some dimensions had been simplified.
questions.explanation: A正确：added note simplified dimensions；B否认模型限制说明。

questions.prompt: The final display kept both models while adding context.
questions.explanation: A正确：still together但读标签；B把补说明误作撤展。
